messages.content: Alice: I paid for our train tickets to the mountains: €180 total. Split equally among the three of us.
Bob: The scenery from the train is absolutely breathtaking!
Charlie: I got snacks for the journey: €36. Shared between all three.
Alice: This mountain air is so refreshing after the city.
Bob: I covered our first dinner at the lodge: €75. Split equally.
Charlie: The hiking trails look amazing for tomorrow.
Alice: I paid for the cable car tickets: €45 total for Bob and me.
Bob: What a stunning view from up here!
Charlie: Lunch at the summit restaurant: €63. Split three ways.
Alice: I got souvenirs for everyone: €90 total. Equal split.
Bob: The descent was much easier than the climb up.
Charlie: I paid for our hot chocolate break: €24. Shared among all three.
Alice: This cozy cabin is perfect for our stay.
Bob: Evening groceries: €42. Alice and Charlie owe me for their portions.
Charlie: The sunset over the mountains is incredible!
Alice: I covered the taxi back to town: €30. Split equally.
Bob: Dinner at the local tavern: €87. Three-way split.
Charlie: These local crafts are so unique.
Alice: Museum entrance fees: €36 total for Bob and me.
Bob: The historical exhibits are fascinating!
Charlie: I got a €12 refund on the cable car tickets for Alice and me.
Alice: Lunch at the café: €54. Shared three ways.
Bob: The weather is perfect for more exploring tomorrow.
Charlie: I paid for the boat tour: €60 total. Equal split among us.
Alice: The lake views from the boat are spectacular!
Bob: Snacks for the tour: €27. Alice and Charlie owe me.
Charlie: I'm really enjoying this trip so far.
Alice: Dinner by the lake: €81. Split three ways.
Bob: The stars are so clear out here away from city lights.
Charlie: I covered our breakfast: €39. Shared equally.
Alice: Bike rentals for the day: €75 total. Bob and I will split this.
Bob: Cycling through these country roads is amazing!
Charlie: Lunch stop: €48. Three-way split.
Alice: I got a €18 refund on the bike rental for Bob and me.
Bob: The countryside smells so fresh after the rain.
Charlie: I paid for our train tickets back: €150. Equal split.
Alice: These memories will last a lifetime.
Bob: Final dinner in town: €93. Shared three ways.
Charlie: I can't believe our trip is almost over!
Alice: Taxi to the station: €21. Split equally.
Bob: I'll miss these mountain views.
Charlie: Breakfast before departure: €33. Three-way split.
Alice: I got souvenirs for our families: €120 total. Equal division.
Bob: The train ride home is much quieter than the way here.
Charlie: I paid for lunch on the train: €51. Shared among all three.
Alice: This has been such a wonderful getaway.
Bob: Final snacks: €30. Alice and Charlie owe me.
Charlie: I can't wait to show everyone our photos!
Alice: I covered the taxi from the station: €27. Split equally.
Bob: Home sweet home! What an amazing trip.

queries.question: Based on the memories from our previous dialogs, calculate for each person their total spending and determine who owes money to whom for settlement. Provide a final settlement plan showing all necessary transactions to clear all debts. Format your answer as a concise list of transactions only, using the format: [Person A] pays [amount] to [Person B], etc.
